title: Sprechen voice Phase 0 — Gemini Live vs OpenAI Realtime

part1_access.keyType: AI Studio Authorization key (AQ.… prefix) — same Generative Language API used today for Lesen/Hören
part1_access.tierAvailableToday: Google AI Studio / Gemini API Free Tier for Live models (official pricing: Free of charge for gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview). Vertex AI is a separate production path — NOT required for the access we already have.

part2_turnTaking_officialDocs.automaticVAD: Default ON — server segments speech turns

pushToTalkEquivalent.how: realtimeInputConfig.automaticActivityDetection.disabled=true, then client sends activityStart / activityEnd (official docs: Disable automatic VAD)

values.NO_INTERRUPTION: model response will not be interrupted

part2_turnTaking_officialDocs.vsOpenAI: Parity for operator priority #1: Gemini has documented PTT (manual activity) + explicit NO_INTERRUPTION; OpenAI has turn_detection:null + interrupt_response knobs. Neither is 'uncontrollable'.

part3_liveProbe.outputTranscriptDe: Hallo! Am Wochenende mag ich es, mich zu entspannen und etwas mit Freunden zu unternehmen. Manchmal lesen wir zusammen oder gehen spazieren. Und was machst du am liebsten? Hast du ein Hobby?

recommendation.forSprechenV1: Gemini Live (gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview) with PTT (VAD disabled) + NO_INTERRUPTION
recommendation.why: Operator priority #1 (no unwanted cutoffs) is met by official Gemini controls — the scare about missing barge-in config was false. Access and free Phase 0 already work on the existing key. Paid audio is cheaper than OpenAI mini. Do not wait on OpenAI account creation for v1.
caveats: Free tier: Google may use data to improve products — use paid for production privacy
Client-to-server should mint ephemeral tokens (docs), not ship long-lived API keys to browsers
Validate real mic + German ASR with a human ear next (this probe used synth tone + text cue)
